remarks: Stately Shippan Point Estate set on a rare 1.64-acre parcel with distant views of Long Island Sound, this distinguished Colonial residence offers an extraordinary living experience in Stamford's most coveted waterfront neighborhood. Included in the sale is an adjoining property with a fully renovated 1,900-square-foot Carriage House, creating a significant compound ideal for entertaining and everyday living. A sweeping circular driveway leads to a grand entrance, opening to a gracious foyer, elegant living room, and formal dining room. The sun-filled family room and sunroom feature stone fireplaces and overlook the pool area and landscaped gardens. A stunning lounge with custom decor by Fine Paints of Europe and a built-in bar adds charm and elegance. The expansive kitchen includes two Wolf ovens, Sub-Zero refrigerator, wine cooler, center island, and sunny breakfast room. Public rooms flow to a pergola-covered dining terrace with outdoor kitchen, 60-foot pool with spa surrounded by Croatian marble, pool house with half bath, and sweeping lawns. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers a fireplace, marble bath, and custom closets. With seven bedrooms, four full baths, two half-baths, a recreation room, gym, and a two-car garage in the Carriage House, the home easily accommodates family and guests. A short walk to Stamford Yacht Club, five minutes to the train, with 45 min express service to NYC! A unique opportunity to own one of the largest landholdings in Shippan Point!
